children: Canada learning technology firm's fiscal Q2 subscription revenue grew 2% yr/yr, impacted by K-12 churn
D2L swings to loss of $3.1mln, due to a non-cash fair value adjustment
Company repurchased about 2 mln Subordinate Voting shares during the quarter
D2L sees FY27 subscription and support revenue at $211 mln to $213 mln, down from $212 mln to $214 mln prior guidance
Company expects FY27 total revenue of $228 mln to $231 mln, down from $231 mln to $234 mln prior guidance
D2L maintains FY27 adjusted EBITDA guidance at $33 mln to $35 mln, or 15% margin at midpoint
K-12 CHURN - Co said subscription and support revenue growth was limited by previously disclosed U.S. K-12 customer churn
HIGHER ED AND CORPORATE GROWTH - Excluding K-12, ARR grew by about 10% yr/yr, driven by new customer wins and expansion in higher education and corporate markets
AI PRODUCT ADOPTION - Broader adoption of D2L Lumi, the co's AI offering, contributed to increased value of customer relationships
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for D2L Inc is C$14.00, about 40.7% above its September 8 closing price of C$9.95
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
